idea-plugin.name: Cranpose
idea-plugin.description:
Tools for developing Cranpose applications in RustRover and IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Finds the applications and examples in the Cargo workspace that use Cranpose, and runs, checks and tests them.
  • Shows the running application in a panel next to the source. Changed values such as numbers, colors and text are applied without compiling. Other code changes are compiled and patched into the running application, which restarts only when the change requires it.
  • Layout inspector with the view tree, sizes, modifiers and source location of each view. Picking a view in the preview opens its source.
  • Controls for numbers, colors and booleans next to the literals in the editor.
  • Stability badges on composable parameters, from the Cranpose stability analyzer.
  • Builds and packages desktop and mobile applications with Cranpose Build.
  • File → New Project → Cranpose creates a project from the Showcase sample.

Building applications requires Rust and the platform build tools. The preview uses a private debug copy of the project; release builds are not affected.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.15.0

  • Preview recomposition counters above composable definitions, using Cranpose 0.9.2 or newer.
  • Shared GPU rendering for animated counters and edit-to-preview lightning on macOS, Windows and Linux. Decorations follow scrolling and stop drawing when idle.
  • A chooser for overlapping Pick targets.
  • Library previews, clearer build progress and isolated build caches for concurrent previews.
